name: MH Scribe
description: MH Scribe is an AI medical scribe built specifically for mental health practitioners. The platform differentiates with Advanced AI Clinical Cards—treatment recommendations, diagnostic insights, risk assessment, and billing suggestions that go beyond basic note generation. Built on AWS HIPAA-compliant infrastructure with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Data is never used to train AI models. MH Scribe offers 5 free AI notes to start (no credit card required) with Standard and Pro tiers available after a 21-day free trial.

faqs.q: How much does MH Scribe cost?
faqs.a: MH Scribe offers 5 free AI notes (no credit card required) to test the platform. Paid plans include Standard and Pro tiers with a 21-day free trial. Specific pricing is not publicly listed—visit mhscribe.ai/pricing for current rates.

faqs.q: What are MH Scribe's Clinical Cards?
faqs.a: Clinical Cards are MH Scribe's AI-powered clinical decision support feature. Beyond basic note generation, they provide treatment recommendations, diagnostic insights, risk assessment, and billing suggestions—helping clinicians with the thinking, not just the typing.
Yes. MH Scribe is built on AWS HIPAA-compliant infrastructure with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Strict role-based access controls. Your data is never used to train AI models.

faqs.q: MH Scribe vs Mentalyc: which is better?
faqs.a: MH Scribe differentiates with Clinical Cards (treatment recommendations, risk assessment). Mentalyc focuses on modality-aware therapy notes (CBT, DBT) and Alliance Genie therapeutic tracking. Mentalyc publishes transparent pricing ($20-70/mo); MH Scribe requires contact for pricing.

faqs.q: Does MH Scribe integrate with my EHR?
faqs.a: MH Scribe does not publish EHR integrations. If native EHR integration is critical, consider Mentalyc (TherapyNotes, ICANotes, TheraNest) or Upheal (SimplePractice, Jane App).
